<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
* Preserve working directories when switching users by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24360
* Add desktop entries for AppImage casks by @syntactic-spice in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24343
* bundle: reject failed uv inventories by @edel67 in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24363
* search: Suppress headers in quiet mode by @abitrolly in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24366
* Preserve sudo routing when switching users by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24361
* Replace `# No zap stanza required` comments by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24369
* Allow resetting Git remotes to their defaults by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24368
* List formula versions using bash by @krehel in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24373
* dev-cmd/bump: search pull requests by short name by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24370
* Prepare cask script permissions before app moves by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24371
* php: Create an empty `conf.d/` directory by @TimWolla in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24377
* Flag unchanged auto_updates apps as outdated by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24382
* create: Strip trailing dot from GitHub description by @abitrolly in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24374
* php: Future-proof OPcache configuration logic for PHP 8.6 by @TimWolla in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24380
* Generate package and Git analytics by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24379
* Detect and mitigate eMudhra certificate trust by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24383
* Handle symlinked prefixes when linking kegs by @iBug in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24376
* cask/macos: add undeletable container directories by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24357
* Keep compatible outdated runtime dependencies by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24384
* Run deleted formula lookup without a shell by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24393
* Require compatibility_version on new dependencies by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24391
* Avoid needless ELF and linkage work on Linux by @krehel in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24392
* Look up formula cache file names by name only by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24395
* Honour installed formula rpath preservation by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24402
* GitHubReleases: upload bottles via draft releases to support immutable releases by @ghostflyby in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24403
* Look up cask cache file names by token only by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24394
* Look up tap cask file names by token only by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24396
* Fix flaky Go bundle cleanup specs by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24401
* cleanup: preserve metadata during dry runs by @hezhizhen in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24406
* Use API tiers as sponsor benefit floors by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24405
* mcp: handle empty arguments and failed commands by @hezhizhen in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24409
* Add formula feed generation command by @andrew in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24410
* Only accept stable and head as formula specs by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24407
* Reject relative tap names and keg aliases by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24411
* workflows: use `case` instead of faux ternary by @carlocab in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24413
* Suggest fixes for missing and outdated test dependencies by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24404
* Link AI docs to Contributing AI/LLM section by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24415
* formula: handle non-VCS head in outdated by @ZTJun in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24412
* GitHubReleases: group bottle uploads by release by @hezhizhen in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24416
* Fix specs on Ubuntu 26.04 runners by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24422
* Pull invalid path components into a constant by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24418
* bundle: reject failed extension inventories by @edel67 in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24417
* Read ELF metadata without elftools by @krehel in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24423
* bundle: preserve formula conflict handling by @thiagogenez in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24356
* Warn when `brew update` leaves a branch unchanged by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24421
* Honour sponsor benefits across platforms by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24414
* Only load dependencies by formula name by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24427
* info: align recursive runtime deps with other deps by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24425
* Call formula specs directly instead of by name by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24429
* info: share the rack installed check by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24426
* Don't report unchanged generated files as errors by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24431
* info: check latest runtime deps before printing by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24430
* Don't retry rate-limited attestation lookups by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24433

## New Contributors
* @syntactic-spice made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24343
* @TimWolla made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24377
* @iBug made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24376
* @ghostflyby made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24403
* @hezhizhen made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24406
* @ZTJun made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24412

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/compare/7.0.11...7.0.12
